none: PAS CAM-4623C3: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of Constans, AD337-350
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGG Q NN ; D/ [...]TAN-S P F AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Constans, AD337-350. Mint is Trier, AD347-348, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads VICTORIAE DD AVGG Q NN. Reverse shows two Victories. See RIC VIII, p.152, no.196. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]TAN-S P F AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: /D//[...]. Condition is very fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is…
